Drug Regulator Cancels 7 Ethics Committees for Non-Compliance

India's Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) has cancelled the registrations of seven Ethics Committees nationwide. The cancellations followed inspections that revealed serious violations of clinical trial rules and guidelines. These committees are responsible for overseeing participant rights and safety during medical studies. The action was taken after a thorough compliance assessment.
